description: Defines an immutable data class 'DisbursementData' representing loan disbursement details, including dates, amounts, and related logic.

classes.name: DisbursementData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing disbursement information, with methods for date handling, comparison, and disbursement status.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a new DisbursementData instance for import purposes with specified actual disbursement date, link account ID, row index, locale, and date format.

methods.name: disbursementDate
methods.description: Returns the effective disbursement date, prioritizing actual disbursement date if available.

methods.name: isDisbursed
methods.description: Checks if the disbursement has occurred based on the presence of actual disbursement date.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this disbursement to another based on expected disbursement date, handling nulls.

methods.name: isDueForDisbursement
methods.description: Determines if the disbursement is due within a date range based on the loan schedule type.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndUpToAndIncluding
methods.description: Checks if a target date falls within a range from a non-inclusive start to an inclusive end.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndIncludingAndUpTo
methods.description: Checks if a target date falls within a range from an inclusive start to a non-inclusive end.

methods.name: getWaivedChargeAmount
methods.description: Returns the waived charge amount, defaulting to zero if null.
